The '''Red Army of Xanaqu''' is the armed force associated with [[Xun Tao]], the [[Taoist Party]], and the founding of the [[People's Federation of Xanaqu]]. The extracted Xanaqu source says the Red Army defeated republican forces in the [[Xanaq Civil War]] and later describes Xanaqu's military as shaped by the state's worker-centered political culture.

This draft uses "Red Army of Xanaqu" as the conservative 1994-back title because that is the clearest formation-era wording in the source.

== Formation Role ==

During the collapse of the [[Bu Dynasty]], republican forces associated with [[General Cheng Jin]] attempted to establish a rival northern state. The Red Army under Xun Tao defeated those forces in a short civil war, allowing the People's Federation to consolidate in 1936.

The source notes that many republican members were pardoned after the victory, suggesting that the new state used military success to secure political integration rather than only repression.

== Later Development ==

By the late twentieth century, Xanaqu's military modernization was supported by state industry, especially [[Xanaqu South Industrial State Cooperation]]. The XSISC source describes defense manufacturing, armored vehicles, aircraft, research and development, and military supply chains as important parts of the company's work.

The XSISC source also uses "People's Liberation Army" wording. Current drafts preserve that as a possible formal or later name variant, but do not replace the Red Army title until the user or stronger canon settles the terminology.
